purpose.target_triangles: One automatic runtime collapse level; dense editable source remains retained. This is not manual retopology.
purpose.source_fps: Animation bake samples only; the native engine owns elapsed combat time.
purpose.body_lift_units: Small supported clearance for the low thorax and abdominal underside; six toes stay planted on the local plane.
purpose.stance_fraction: 65 percent ground contact per foot gives the heavy nymph overlapping alternating tripods.
purpose.step_units: Source fore/aft foot sweep; no movement or contact reach is driven by the clip.
purpose.foot_lift_units: Five-hundredths of a source unit of swing clearance on a flat floor.
purpose.breath_units: Restrained idle thorax breathing with planted feet.
purpose.head_windup_radians: Brace and lift the source head through the native warning fraction.
purpose.head_followthrough_radians: Short downward head release following the actual melee event.
purpose.labium_windup_radians: Tuck the existing compact labium in anticipation.
purpose.labium_release_radians: Brief opening of the source-supported folded mouthpart; no persistent grab.
purpose.labium_extension_units: A short local 0.045-unit mouthpart release. It adds no tether, reach or hitbox.
purpose.antenna_sweep_radians: Quiet supported antenna motion independent of game RNG.
purpose.abdomen_flex_radians: Very small supported segmented-abdomen flex; layered ruptures keep their material and weights together.
purpose.durations: Authored clip spans; windup is normalized from native tuning, recovery resampled into the existing cosmetic window.
purpose.uniform_metres_per_source_unit: Grounded uniform .82 scale before the native 1.4 family size and any elite size, applied once. Lurker has no .76 humanoid reduction.
purpose.cosmetic_stride_metres: At native 1.8m/s and family 1.4 this gives about 1.43 heavy gait cycles/sec, accepting foot sliding without changing motion.
purpose.cull_margin_source_units: Keeps moving toes and the short labium action inside the visual culling envelope.
purpose.joints: Measured Z-up, -Y-forward nymph source landmarks, independent of beetle pivots. All six hips lie on the thorax; abdomen stays legless.
